summary: Evidence adapter for ordinary (multiclass) accuracy rules: aligns baseline and candidate held-out predictions with labels by example id (fails closed on any mismatch, duplicate or non-finite value) and emits this arm's rows in slot 'predictions' for eidos.assessors.paired-ci@1.1.0 metric 'accuracy'. Use one job per arm and training seed (config.role, config.cluster); eidos.templates.improves-under-budget@1.2.0 'classification' requests plan this for you.

accuracy.numerator: examples whose prediction equals the label

role.description: the arm whose rows this run emits; run the component once in each arm

cluster.description: training seed shared by the baseline and candidate predictions, e.g. "11"

classes.description: optional allowed class labels; any label or prediction outside them is refused
